sex.quote: To study male genitalia, the standard methods of Kevan et al. (1969) and Martinelli et al. (2017) for the extraction and preparation of internal genitalia were followed.
Images of male and female genitalia were also taken at the ZMH with a Keyence VHX-7000
For all traits, male and female samples were measured separately.
Type materials examined. Holotype • ♂; Gabon. Near Youmi, in forest habitat; 0°24.617'N, 9°26.200'E; 11 Jun. 1974; M. Donskoff & J. Le Breton leg.; MNHN, MNHN-EO-CAELIF11462.
Other material examined. Cameroon • 1 ♀, subadult; Somalomo, in the Dja Biosphere Reserve, cocoa farm; 3°23.650'N, 12°53.583'E, 606 m a.s.l.; 11 Apr. 2022; J.A. Yetchom Fondjo leg.; SMNK.
Cameroon • 4 ♀♀; Ongot; 3°42.517'N, 11°15.167'E; 15 Jun. 2020; J.A. Yetchom Fondjo leg.; SMNK.
Cameroon • 2 ♂♂; Iboti, Ebo forest; 4°27.001'N, 10°27.002'E, 731 m a.s.l.; 7 Jan. 2022; J.A. Yetchom Fondjo leg.; SMNK.

basisOfRecord.quote: Photographs with data on the distributions of all known species are given.
Field surveys were conducted from June 2017 to April 2022 at various locations situated in the central (Ongot), eastern (Somalomo, Dja), and littoral (Sohock, Koukoué, Iboti) regions of Cameroon.
In addition, type specimens held in the Muséum Nationale d´Histoire Naturelle Paris, France (**MNHN**) and the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin, Germany (**MfN**) were examined.
Distributional data were obtained from geographical coordinates recorded during field observations and from locality records taken from specimen labels in the ZMH and the MNHN collections.

lifeStage.quote: Other material examined. Cameroon • 1 ♀, subadult; Somalomo, in the Dja Biosphere Reserve, cocoa farm; 3°23.650'N, 12°53.583'E, 606 m a.s.l.; 11 Apr. 2022; J.A. Yetchom Fondjo leg.; SMNK.
The last female subadult stage was collected during this study and represents the first signalization of this species in Cameroon.
